description: What the other plan mode writes in place of a field that only one mode has. The places of every field name are read from the schema the run froze (functions/field-homes.ts, fieldHomes); only what the schema cannot say is declared here: that a block plan carries the same fact somewhere else. Every place named here is checked against slots.schema.json by functions/field-homes.test.ts.
